notes.title: Japanese Localization Update
notes.notes:
皆さん、こんにちは！

以前のバージョンで英語と日本語が混在していたことについて、まずお詫び申し上げます。シームレスな言語体験の重要性を理解しており、この問題を解決するために一生懸命取り組んできました。バージョン 0.3.1.0 には、多数のローカリゼーション更新が行われています。

しかし、まだ改善が必要な部分があることを認識しており、特に船の名前や星系の名前が英語のままであることについてご承知ください。これらの問題を今後のアップデートで解決するために積極的に取り組んでいます。

皆さんのご理解と引き続きのご支援を感謝申し上げます。皆さんの体験をより良くするために努力してまいります。ありがとうございました！

Hello Everyone,
We would like to start by apologizing for the mixing of English and Japanese in our previous builds. We understand the importance of a seamless language experience, and we have been working diligently to address this issue. Version 0.3.1.0 has had a large number of localization updates.

However, we acknowledge that there are still areas that need improvement, specifically the ship names and star system names, which remain in English. We are actively working to resolve these issues in future updates.
We appreciate your understanding and continued support as we strive to make your experience better. Thank you!

notes.title: Difficulty Adjustments and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
We have added UI Scaling options to allow for more control over how the UI is displayed. We are sure there are edge cases we have missed in this setup, and are ready for feedback.

[h3]Updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*] UI Scaling:
    - Warp Panel now scales better
    - Market Panel now scales better
    - Currently only scales the UI within the game
[*] Improved Captain Mini Panel Design
[*] Market Panel Logic for Buy and Selling
[*] Improved Reporting Issues upload system
[*] Improved Localization
[/list]

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Addressed an issue with Difficulty below Normal
[*] Addressed an issue with Commodity Quantity calculation for some Star Systems 
[*] Addressed an issue with Reporting Issues edge cases
[/list]
